text: Grandma here, looking after my granddaughter, she's 18 months. Temp is 39.2. She's teething badly, dribbling non stop, chewing anything she can get her hands on and one cheek is bright red. She's also got a few insect bites on her legs that she keeps scratching at. I've been up with her for hours and I'm shattered. Is this just the teeth or should the temperature be that high with teething
